details: Strong US labor market data released on August 6, 2026, has intensified expectations for a potential Federal Reserve interest rate hike, despite the Fed holding rates steady in its July meeting. This hawkish shift in sentiment has contributed to a modest decline across the broader cryptocurrency market, with stablecoins and Decentralized Finance (DeFi) tokens experiencing notable weakness. Investors are now closely watching the upcoming US July CPI inflation data, due August 12, for further signals on the Fed's policy trajectory.
title: US Labor Data Fuels Fed Hike Fears, Weighs on Crypto

details: Reports indicating progress toward a diplomatic breakthrough between the US and Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz have led to a pullback in oil prices. This easing of geopolitical tensions in the Middle East has had a positive effect on global equity markets, helping to alleviate some inflation concerns and support a technology-led rally in US stocks. The S&P 500 recently reached new all-time highs amidst this calming geopolitical backdrop and strong corporate earnings.
title: Oil Prices Ease on Hopes for Mideast Deal, Boosting Stocks

details: The US Senate has postponed its floor vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act until September 2026. The delay is attributed to unresolved ethics provisions within the bill, specifically concerning federal officials' ability to issue or sponsor digital assets. This continued regulatory uncertainty, despite the bill's aim to clarify oversight between the SEC and CFTC, could weigh on the sentiment of the cryptocurrency industry. Bitcoin showed a muted reaction, trading flat around $64,100-$64,400 following the announcement.
title: US Crypto CLARITY Act Vote Delayed to September Amid Ethics Concerns
